blockquote: A multi-paragraph quote splits into separate quotes.
callout: The data-type="callout" HTML block is dropped.
columns: The data-type="columns" HTML block is dropped.
footnotes: The footnote reference and definition are dropped.
links-and-images: The autolink <https://...> is rewritten as an inline link.
lists: The nested list item is dropped.
math: The backslash escape in \, is lost inside $$ math.
mermaid: The mermaid fence is wrapped in cept:block comments.
table: Column padding and the :---- alignment marker are normalised.
toggle-details: <details>/<summary> toggles lose their summary and wrapper.
unknown-html: Unknown HTML blocks and HTML comments are dropped.
